# vendor

Third-party binaries from [voidtools](https://www.voidtools.com/), both MIT-licensed
and Authenticode-signed by "voidtools PTY LTD" (signature verified on download).

| File | Source | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `Everything64.dll` | https://www.voidtools.com/Everything-SDK.zip (`dll/Everything64.dll`) | SDK for Everything 1.4.1 |
| `es.exe` | https://www.voidtools.com/ES-1.1.0.38.x64.zip | ES 1.1.0.38 x64 |

`Everything64.dll` is only the client SDK: it talks to the Everything **application**
(1.4.1+), which must be installed separately and running in the background.
